RootQuery.hbBanner(language: String): HbBanner
RootQuery.hbCompanyInfo: HbCompanyInfo
RootQuery.hbOpeningHours(language: String): HbOpeningHours
RootQuery.hbPopup(language: String): HbPopup

type HbBanner {
  databaseId: Int!
  endsAt: String
  link: HbBannerCta
  startsAt: String
  text: String
}

type HbBannerCta {
  target: String!
  url: String!
}

type HbCompanyAddress {
  country: String
  emails: [HbCompanyContact!]!
  locality: String
  mapsUrl: String
  name: String
  phones: [HbCompanyContact!]!
  postalCode: String
  region: String
  street: String
}

type HbCompanyContact {
  label: String
  value: String!
}

type HbCompanyInfo {
  address: HbCompanyAddress
  certifiedEmail: String
  email: String
  invoiceCode: String
  legalName: String
  mobile: String
  name: String
  offices: [HbCompanyAddress!]!
  phone: String
  privacyEmail: String
  profiles: [HbCompanyProfile!]!
  registrationNumber: String
  shareCapital: String
  taxCode: String
  vatId: String
}

type HbCompanyProfile {
  network: String
  url: String!
}

type HbOpeningHours {
  currentWeek: [HbOpeningHoursDay!]!
  displayName: String
  regularWeek: [HbOpeningHoursDay!]!
  source: HbOpeningHoursSourceEnum!
  specialDays: [HbOpeningHoursSpecialDay!]!
  syncedAt: String
}

type HbOpeningHoursDay {
  day: String!
  isClosed: Boolean!
  periods: [HbOpeningHoursPeriod!]!
  slots: [String!]!
}

type HbOpeningHoursPeriod {
  closes: String!
  opens: String!
}

enum HbOpeningHoursSourceEnum {
  GOOGLE
  MANUAL
}

type HbOpeningHoursSpecialDay {
  endDate: String!
  isClosed: Boolean!
  note: String
  periods: [HbOpeningHoursPeriod!]!
  slots: [String!]!
  startDate: String!
}

type HbPopup {
  content: String
  databaseId: Int!
  days: Int!
  endsAt: String
  image: HbPopupImage
  link: HbPopupCta
  startsAt: String
  title: String
}

type HbPopupCta {
  target: String!
  title: String!
  url: String!
}

type HbPopupImage {
  node: MediaItem
}
